headline: Chiefs 33-30 Colts: Butker nails 40-yard winner in overtime thriller
whyCareReason: A 30-30 Sunday night shootout goes to overtime before Harrison Butker drills a 40-yard winner at Arrowhead to keep Kansas City perfect at 2-0.
teaser: FINAL (OT): Chiefs 33, Colts 30. Butker 40-yard field goal in overtime. Mahomes drives Kansas City to 2-0. Attendance 73,420.
story:
Why this one matters: Thursday gave us a 41-31 track meet in Orchard Park. Sunday night at Arrowhead answered with a 33-30 overtime epic that sent Kansas City to 2-0.

Sky Sports, CBS and Chiefs.com agree on the dramatic scoreline: 30-30 after four quarters of relentless back-and-forth football. Patrick Mahomes orchestrated a tense fourth-quarter comeback before Indianapolis answered with a field goal to force the extra period.

In overtime, Kansas City's defense held firm on the opening possession, allowing Mahomes and the offense to march into range. Harrison Butker calmly stepped up and drilled a 40-yard kick through the uprights. Kansas City 2-0, Indianapolis 0-2.
stakes: Kansas City stays atop the AFC West at 2-0, while the Colts fall to 0-2 despite a valiant road effort.
rivalryAngle: Another memorable chapter between two storied AFC franchises, decided in sudden-death overtime.
